subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: If a proposal diff modifies verification machinery — the manifest, a baseline, or harness configuration — then rung 0 shall fail with a machinery finding naming the path.
rationale: the implementer must not adjudicate its own gate; baselines are the most gameable artifact in a brownfield setup
fit_criterion: catch seed 3 (a baseline addition riding a proposal diff) is blocked in the permanent catch suite; fixture diffs not touching machinery paths never trigger the finding
